name: kilometrica
description: Kilometrica monorepo: Python audit engine (engine/, runs in Ubuntu/WSL), TypeScript API (api/) and prototype web app (web/)

scripts.fetch:ev8: wsl -d Ubuntu-24.04 -- bash scripts/dpg fetch eurovelo EV8
scripts.ingest:ev8: wsl -d Ubuntu-24.04 -- bash scripts/dpg ingest eurovelo EV8
scripts.osm:ev8: wsl -d Ubuntu-24.04 -- bash scripts/dpg osm-prepare eurovelo EV8
scripts.audit:ev8: wsl -d Ubuntu-24.04 -- bash scripts/dpg audit eurovelo EV8
scripts.valhalla:up: wsl -d Ubuntu-24.04 -- bash scripts/valhalla up eurovelo ev8
scripts.valhalla:down: wsl -d Ubuntu-24.04 -- bash scripts/valhalla down eurovelo ev8
scripts.contracts: wsl -d Ubuntu-24.04 -- bash scripts/dpg schemas && json2ts -i schemas/bundle-v0.schema.json -o packages/contracts/src/bundle.ts --no-additionalProperties --bannerComment "/* Generated from schemas/bundle-v0.schema.json by `npm run contracts`. Do not edit. */"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @dpg/api" "npm run dev -w @dpg/web"
scripts.test: npm run engine:test && npm run test -w @dpg/api && npm run test -w @dpg/dream
